body.input: Which health tech companies hired a country manager for Norway in 2026?

response.content:
Based on available information, one notable health tech-related "country manager for Norway" appointment in 2026 is:

- **Coloplast Norge AS** — **Lena Nymo Helli**, the former CEO of Norway Health Tech (Norway's largest health technology cluster), stepped down from her role effective March 31, 2026, to take on a new position as **Country Manager at Coloplast Norge AS**. Coloplast is a global medtech company specializing in intimate healthcare products (ostomy, continence, wound care, and interventional urology).

No other specific health tech company appointments of a "country manager for Norway" during 2026 were identified in the sources reviewed. The broader Norwegian health tech ecosystem has been active in 2026 — with leadership changes at Norway Health Tech itself (Sveinung Tornås was appointed as the new CEO, effective May 1, 2026) — but those are cluster-level roles rather than country manager positions at health tech companies.

context.content:
Norway’s largest health cluster, Norway Health Tech (NHT), announces today that CEO Lena Nymo Helli has resigned from her position. Helli will take on a new leadership role as Country Manager at Coloplast Norge AS. She will continue in her current role until March 31, 2026. [...] – “Lena has elevated the cluster to a national force within health technology and medtech. Under her leadership, we have changed our operating model, merged two clusters into one united organization, and positioned health technology as a future export industry for Norway. She has been a bold and clear voice on behalf of our members and helped put health technology on the national agenda,” says Janne T. Morstøl, Chair of the Board at Norway Health Tech. [...] – “After almost five years at Norway Health Tech, I am ready for the next step in my career. It has been an amazing journey to lead the cluster and work with our member companies to create growth and accelerate the implementation of new solutions in the health services,” says Lena Nymo Helli.

# Sveinung Tornås appointed new CEO of Norway Health Tech

With solid experience in innovation, digital transformation and collaboration between the healthcare sector and industry, Sveinung Tornås will lead Norway’s largest health cluster moving forward.

## Written by

### Therese Oppegaard

Press release, Oslo 09.02.2026 [...] The Board believes that the appointment of Sveinung Tornås is a strong strategic move for Norway Health Tech and a natural choice considering the cluster’s strategic direction. [...] Norway Health Tech is Norway’s largest health cluster, with more than 350 members and partners across the entire healthcare value chain. The cluster works to strengthen the Norwegian health industry by facilitating the development, industrialisation and scaling of health technology solutions – with the aim of more sustainable healthcare services in Norway and increased international success for Norwegian companies.

Sveinung Tornås will assume the role of CEO on May 1st.
